query: For my 67-year-old male patient, what's the interquartile range of the first recorded SpO2 among males aged 62–72?
final_sql:
WITH first_spo2 AS (
  SELECT 
      p.subject_id,
      ce.valuenum AS spo2_value,
      EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ce.charttime) - (p.anchor_year - p.anchor_age) AS age_at_event,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY ce.subject_id 
          ORDER BY ce.charttime
      ) AS rn
  FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce
  INNER JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
      ON ce.subject_id = p.subject_id
  WHERE 
      ce.itemid = 220277   -- SpO2 measurement
      AND ce.valuenum IS NOT NULL
      AND p.gender = 'M'   -- Male patients
)
SELECT 
    APPROX_QUANTILES(spo2_value, 4)[OFFSET(1)] AS q1,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(spo2_value, 4)[OFFSET(3)] AS q3,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(spo2_value, 4)[OFFSET(3)] - APPROX_QUANTILES(spo2_value, 4)[OFFSET(1)] AS iqr
FROM first_spo2
WHERE 
    rn = 1                 -- First SpO2 per patient
    AND age_at_event BETWEEN 62 AND 72; -- Age filter;
